phases.objective: Prevent MariaDB 11.4 ERROR 1901 from unsupported LOWER/LCASE wrappers in stored generated expressions while preserving the immutable historical migration and all downstream automation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed CI and staging-local Windows migration operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-head static governance followed by freshly authorized disposable Windows Docker MariaDB 11.4 schema-only replay
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The generated-expression ordered-chain guard reports zero unresolved unsupported expressions, the DDL-only compatibility bridge preserves the source schema contract, and any later local replay stops before AutoPilot, importer, readback, deployment, provider, or Production action on the first MariaDB error.
steps: Classify the exact base-to-head changes and record the required environment impact declaration.
Verify all generated expressions statically, including forbidden function detection, exact bridge ordering, and DDL-only bridge content.
Verify the immutable storage-control migration remains unchanged and the bridge precreates both related tables with the original foreign keys.
Verify enum, text-width, collation, index-width, required-INSERT, pre-use, arity, and governance contracts remain clean.
After a fresh merged main head and a new exact-SHA authorization, run only the disposable local Windows Docker MariaDB 11.4 schema-only replay.
Stop before AutoPilot, importer, readback, data export/import, deployment, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, or Production operations on any failure.
assertions: The generated-expression guard is static-only and fails closed on every forbidden function without an exact ordered bridge.
The compatibility bridge is DDL-only, preserves the original storage tables and foreign keys, and does not modify the historical migration.
The plan and manifest expose generated_expression_checks, compatibility_bridge_candidates, unsupported_generated_expressions, and allowed_compatibility_bridges.
No database, provider, credential, export, runtime, deployment, Production, AutoPilot, importer, or readback mutation is introduced by static governance or this declaration.
production_mutation_allowed is false and secrets_included is false.
